title: Repair Helius live mint read contract
objective: Repair only the Helius live mint read after the authorized smoke proved the original mint RPC contract invalid. Read finalized SPL mint account data through a supported Helius JSON-RPC request, retain the existing request budget, timeout, fail-closed behavior and credential containment, and add only offline unit coverage for the corrected contract.
forbidden_actions: Do not print, store, commit or record credentials, bearer values, raw provider payloads, or credential-bearing URLs.
Do not broaden the provider set beyond Helius or add fallback RPC endpoints.
Do not activate BSC, Robinhood, scheduler, cron, background loops, automated discovery, or production database writes.
